verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for a SaaS commerce/POS platform, so the axis applies. The pack shows no way to issue least-privilege API credentials or tokens for an agent. Custom staff roles and PINs govern human staff access, and POS UI extensions calling the GraphQL Admin API are a developer building block; neither is a scoped-credential capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
